We need to determine number of aromatic carbon atoms in the compound. But we have no description of compound. Possibly earlier context? Not provided. We may need to retrieve NMR spectra to infer aromatic carbons? But we don't know the molecule. Maybe the system expects we use carbon NMR to count aromatic carbons. Could request carbon_nmr_spectra which returns a string with peaks and maybe assignments. Then count aromatic carbon peaks (typically 6-8). But we need integer.

We have no SMILES. The tool carbon_nmr_spectra takes no arguments (sample at hand). So there is a sample context preloaded. Likely the environment has a specific compound. So we can call carbon_nmr_spectra to get 13C NMR data. Then interpret aromatic carbon signals (around 120-150 ppm). Count number of distinct aromatic carbon peaks. Might be overlapping but typical.

Let's call carbon_nmr_spectra.
